source_event.summary: Canonical documentation retained a superseded normative authorization/default claim after executable policy changed.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An executable policy can change successfully while canonical documentation continues to state the previous normative authorization, default, provisioning, availability, or allow/deny behavior.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Rely on green behavioral tests and a pull-request summary without deriving old/new normative claims and searching canonical sources outside the diff.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: DOC-SEMANTIC-DRIFT-001: derive old/new contract terms, search repository-wide on the final material candidate, classify normative occurrences, and block unresolved current contradictions.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Whenever executable behavior changes a normative policy, activate documentation as a material risk family and update affected canonical sources in the same delivery before freeze.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The internal handoff gate must require a documentation canonical-claims adversarial surface with old/new terms, outside-diff search evidence, classified occurrences, and zero unresolved contradictions.

transfer_cases.scenario: Synthetic role changes from denied to allowed while a canonical product source still says the action is not granted automatically; the gate must reject until reconciled.
Synthetic feature changes from disabled-by-default to enabled-by-default while a runbook keeps the former default as current; the gate must reject until reconciled.

skill_changes.evidence: documentacao-repositorio now activates repository-wide contradiction scanning for normative authorization, default, seed, provisioning, and availability changes.
entregar-issue now requires DOC-SEMANTIC-DRIFT-001 and documentation:canonical-claims coverage before handoff; independent audit trigger was expanded consistently.
